# Opium

> Opium is a short-form vertical video community — Clippy reels, stories, creator messaging, and discovery in a sleek dark-themed feed.

## Pages

- [Home](/): For You and Following video feed with stories bar.
- [Clippy](/clipy): Vertical video feed with tap-to-toggle audio.
- [Discover](/discover): Masonry grid of trending creators and posts.
- [Reels](/reels): Full-screen short-video reels with Remix.
- [Search](/search): Find users, videos, and hashtags.
- [Sounds](/sounds): Browse music and audio tracks used in reels.
- [Live](/live): Live streams and scheduled broadcasts.
- [Help](/help): Support and FAQ.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Email and Google authentication.
